$comment: Single source of truth for the harness model catalog. Consumed by both TS (harness-models.ts) and deploy scripts (harness-models.mjs). Each entry pins a model to a known-good (provider, apiFormat) pair so the AgentCore harness loop produces a request shape valid for THAT model's endpoint. See harness-models.ts for the full rationale. Pre-bump entries are retained for backward compat — existing harness configs and historical references still resolve them; do not remove.
